hypothesis: W-R30 proved latent missingness is ambiguous from observed marker bytes. Evaluate how treating legitimate all-zero, all-255 or repeated rows as missing affects W-R25's actual ordered-pair classifier, using its unchanged learned weights and a balanced local-swap task.
freeze: All observation generator families, marker types, fixed marker-at-swap-row interventions, swap-site pairs, heldout seeds and decision criteria committed prior to first original execution. No changes after evaluation, no use of W-R30 first-use heldout.
training: Recompute W-R22 fixed maskaware_augmented perceptron once from its frozen original dev seeds240..255 (1728 examples, 16 weights+bias, LR0.1, 32 epochs). No new training, calibration, threshold or model capacity for any arm.
world_generation: Start with the exact W-R20 16x4 generator. Produce candidate with genuine time-varying four-channel noise. In marker cases, substitute a LEGITIMATELY OBSERVED marker at the first observation involved in the subsequent adjacent tail swap (global tick11 or13); nothing is erased. Positive candidate keeps its order; negative swaps that observed marker row and adjacent genuine sample. Both positive and negative share candidate anchor and multiset.
arms: old_zero: W-R22 frozen zero-row exclusion feature
multi_marker: W-R25 observed zero/255/repeated-row exclusion feature
all_observed: no rows excluded, original W-R19 top-two all-channel transition feature applied to unchanged W-R22 frozen weights
primary: 24 heldout cells per arm (3 generators×4 marker conditions×2 swap positions). Report per-seed TP/TN/FP/FN, downstream balanced accuracy and marker detector false exclusion of each genuinely observed row. LEGITIMATE_MARKER_COST iff multi_marker loses >=0.10 aggregate accuracy relative all_observed on noncontrol marker cells; TRADEOFF iff there exist >=0.10 per-cell losses and >=0.10 per-cell gains; NO_CONFIRMED_COST otherwise. Retain all adverse and null outcomes.
controls: Legitimate marker rows are *adversarially constructed*, not a natural frequency estimate
Exactly identical W-R22 weights and training examples across three feature arms
No privileged validity flag passed to any feature model
Same 16 actual observations, no hidden oracle, model-call or width change
Preregistered original archive then one full Go integration regression; no first-use replay or accepted-ref mutation
claim_limit: Synthetic adversarial legitimate-value encoding effect on paired sequence classification; not general learning or natural incidence.
